items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I'm sure he heard Bolden, but I don't think that he had a clear picture in his mind of who he was.

ctx.x: Uh, I don't even know if he was that much interested in it. Uh-huh. You know, we just heard some musicians around town like we all did. Yeah. And I assumed that he responded positively to it, but I'm, I'm not, uh, the really great musicians were contemporaries of his, so I doubt whether he'd have been influenced by anybody. Uh-huh. Uh, I'm sure he heard Bolden, but I don't think that he had a clear picture in his mind of who he was. You really, you do think even at his age he would have heard Bolden?
